notes: Capital House trade integrity. (1) Exploit fix: Capital House and legacy guild fund trades now apply the same large-order price impact as personal orders - they fill off the post-impact price and push the tape up/down, instead of filling flat at the live quote. Closes a frictionless buy-pump-dump path used to print ~1B in a day; sub-threshold (under F1,000,000 notional) house trades still fill flat, so ordinary activity is unchanged. (2) Capital House buy rate limit: a player house may execute at most one buy per 30 min across every buy path (direct trade and vote-passed proposal); sells are uncapped. Derived from the fund activity log so it survives restarts and only a successful buy advances the window. Dev (FLSH) and guild (patreon) funds are exempt. SERVER + DB-logic change (server/server.js, server/db.js - additive helper, no schema change): pm2 restart fleshmarket required.
